evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Implement robust testing, documentation and validation practices to ensure data sets are reliable and audit-ready
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities are dominated by testing, documentation, validation, audit-readiness, and regulatory compliance with no velocity/speed language, giving a clear rigour classification.
evidence.domain_risk: We are building a BCBS 239-compliant data warehouse that will serve as the single source of truth for regulatory reporting and risk management.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Explicit regulatory compliance (BCBS 239), financial governance, and audit framing in a fintech (banking/payments) context places this squarely at high domain risk.
evidence.data_team_maturity: With a robust cloud data platform already in place, we're looking for an experienced Analytics Engineer to accelerate the delivery of reliable, high-quality data products.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing cloud data platform and named tools (Azure Databricks, dbt) in active responsibilities, plus a 'growing' team framing, indicate a mid-stage function scaling rather than starting from zero.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design, develop and maintain data models on Azure Databricks using dbt and SQL
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise tools (Azure Databricks, dbt, SQL), a specific compliance framework (BCBS 239), and concrete deliverables (gold layer datasets) — hiring_manager authorship.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Brand New Day is strengthening its data foundation to better support Finance, Risk, and Regulatory Reporting.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's entire framing centers on Finance, Risk, and Regulatory Reporting datasets — a clear finance orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: you'll help build and maintain the data model for our regulatory reporting and risk management datasets
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role executes and maintains data models against pre-defined regulatory requirements rather than setting strategic direction, placing it at execution despite the mission-critical framing.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI tools, AI-assisted coding, or AI-consuming infrastructure anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Implement robust testing, documentation and validation practices to ensure data sets are reliable and audit-ready
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and validation are framed as an owned responsibility with an accountable outcome (audit-readiness), not merely a tool in a skills list.

evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: High: repeated regulatory/audit/compliance framing throughout ('BCBS 239-compliant', 'audit-ready', 'stand up to audits and pressure from regulatory deadlines') reflects a dominant risk-and-compliance register.

evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Building a new compliance-specific data warehouse (greenfield) atop an already-existing cloud platform (fix/scale) gives a mixed signal.
